_comment: 1.8.5 Skills. Four skills level 1-10 by doing what players already do (src/systems/Skills.ts). xpLevels[n] = total XP needed to reach level n+1. xp maps a game stat (an incStat name) to the XP each count gives. Each level gives the 'perLevel' bonus (numbers in 'values'); at levels 5 and 10 the player picks one of two perks. All numbers here can be tuned without code changes (see BALANCE.md > Skills).

skills.name: Farming
skills.about: Grows as you harvest crops and fruit.

5.name: Big Harvest
5.text: 1 harvest in 10 gives a double crop

10.name: Master Farmer
10.text: A further 5% chance of gold crops

10.name: Seed Saver
10.text: Now and then a harvest gives your seed money back

skills.name: Animals
skills.about: Grows as you collect eggs, milk, wool and more.

5.name: Happy Herd
5.text: A quarter of the time an animal carries on without needing new feed

5.name: Prize Animals
5.text: More silver and gold animal products

10.name: Shepherd
10.text: A bonus animal product every day

10.name: Breeder
10.text: One extra space in every animal home

skills.name: Fishing
skills.about: Grows with every fish you land at the dock.
skills.perLevel: A wider green zone when reeling in

5.name: Quick Cast
5.text: Fish bite sooner after you cast

10.name: Legend Hunter
10.text: Legendary and mythic fish bite more often

10.name: Fishmonger
10.text: Fish sell for 25% more in the barn

skills.name: Cooking
skills.about: Grows as your workshops finish goods.

5.name: Batch Cook
5.text: Now and then a batch makes double

5.name: Chef
5.text: Goods sell for 10% more in the barn

10.name: Head Chef
10.text: An extra queue place in every workshop

skills.name: Crafting
skills.about: Opens when Bram's Workshop is rebuilt in the village square. Grows with everything you craft at his forge.
skills.perLevel: A better chance that a craft makes an extra one

5.name: Thrifty Smith
5.text: Crafts use a quarter fewer materials

5.name: Sturdy Tools
5.text: Sprinklers and auto-feeders reach one tile further

10.name: Golden Touch
10.text: Quality fertiliser is twice as strong

10.name: Tinkerer
10.text: Auto-feeders feed twice as many animals
